paper_title: Limits on Axion Couplings from the first 80-day data of PandaX-II Experiment
notes: Solar axion (CBRD) limit g_Ae <= 4e-13 (90% CL) over 1e-5 to 1 keV/c2 (abstract says ~4.35e-12 but body/Fig.3 states 4e-13, treated as largely mass-independent). Galactic ALP limit g_Ae <= 4e-13 (down to 4.3e-14 best) for 1-25 keV/c2 with local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3. Also a 57Fe de-excitation limit reaching 6e-14 at 10 keV. Data points approximate flat horizontal segments for solar (span 1e-5 to 1 keV in eV: 1e-2 to 1e3 eV) and galactic (1e3 to 2.5e4 eV).
